definitions.de: erklären / mitteilen / informieren – jemandem etwas erklären oder eine Information weitergeben
definitions.en: to explain / to inform / to clarify – to explain something to someone or to pass on information
definitions.es: explicar / informar / aclarar – explicar algo a alguien o comunicar una información
definitions.fr: expliquer / informer / clarifier – expliquer quelque chose à quelqu'un ou communiquer une information
definitions.hi: समझाना / बताना / सूचित करना – किसी को कुछ समझाना या जानकारी देना
definitions.ja: 説明する／伝える／知らせる – 誰かに何かを説明したり情報を伝えたりする
definitions.km: ពន្យល់ / ជម្រាប / ប្រាប់ – ពន្យល់អ្វីមួយដល់នរណាម្នាក់ ឬផ្តល់ព័ត៌មាន
definitions.ko: 설명하다 / 알리다 / 전달하다 – 누군가에게 무언가를 설명하거나 정보를 전달하다
definitions.ne: बुझाउनु / जानकारी दिनु / स्पष्ट गर्नु – कसैलाई केही बुझाउनु वा जानकारी दिनु
definitions.pt: explicar / informar / esclarecer – explicar algo a alguém ou transmitir uma informação
definitions.th: อธิบาย / แจ้ง / ชี้แจง – อธิบายบางสิ่งให้ใครทราบ หรือส่งต่อข้อมูล
definitions.tl: ipaliwanag / ipaalam / linawin – ipaliwanag ang isang bagay sa isang tao o magbigay ng impormasyon
definitions.ur: سمجھانا / بتانا / آگاہ کرنا – کسی کو کچھ سمجھانا یا معلومات دینا
definitions.vi: giải thích / thông báo / làm rõ – giải thích điều gì đó cho ai hoặc truyền đạt thông tin
definitions.zh: 解释 / 说明 / 告知 – 向某人解释某事或传达信息
definitions.zh_Hant: 解釋 / 說明 / 告知 – 向某人解釋某事或傳達資訊

definition_en: to explain / to inform / to clarify – to explain something to someone or to pass on information
